units.source_text: 然而，概率法则“可能性与反复成正比例”又不像是假的。

en.t: And yet the law of probability, that possibility is directly proportional to repetition, did not seem to be false after all.

units.source_text: 他不再期待，几乎是破罐子破摔的心情了，

en.t: He had stopped expecting anything, almost in a mood of reckless resignation,

units.source_text: 可投到第十几次的时候，绳索笔直地飞过了草包之上。

en.t: but when he had thrown it for the tenth or so time, the rope flew straight over the straw sack.

units.source_text: 他忍不住打了个寒噤，嘴里麻酥酥的。

en.t: He could not help shuddering, and his mouth tingled numb.

units.source_text: 吞下唾沫的嘴里，唾沫又溢了出来。

en.t: In the mouth where he had just swallowed his saliva, saliva welled up again.

units.source_text: 现在欣喜得意，实在还太早……

en.t: It was still far too early to rejoice and feel triumphant now...

units.source_text: 总算买签卜卦的钱到手了……

en.t: At last he had the money in hand to buy a lot and have his fortune told...

units.source_text: 到底中不中那是以后的事呢。

en.t: Whether it would actually win or not was a matter for later.

units.source_text: 他把全部的精神托付在绳索上，

en.t: He entrusted his entire spirit to the rope,

units.source_text: 他觉得好像在用蜘蛛的丝把星星拉过来似的，轻轻地拉到手边。

en.t: as though he were drawing a star toward him with a spider's thread, gently pulling it close to his hand.
